title: Concept: Type-preserving deserializer used (csharp)
description: In csharp, new NetDataContractSerializer(payload) rebuilds objects from type metadata carried in the payload. That metadata is attacker-controlled whenever the bytes crossed a boundary, so deserialization becomes object construction on demand.
applicability: Legacy .NET services, remoting endpoints, session state and cache formats; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Remote code execution through gadget chains during deserialization; HIGH severity.
